title: RADAR: A RISK-AWARE DYNAMIC MULTI-AGENT FRAMEWORK FOR LLM SAFETY EVALUATION VIA ROLE-SPECIALIZED COLLABORATION
reasoning: The paper is dedicated to the safety evaluation of LLMs, specifically targeting risks such as hateful speech, discrimination, and violence incitement. It introduces a new evaluation framework and benchmarks models using safety-oriented datasets like Red Team, Implicit Toxicity, and DiaSafety, which assess the ethical and moral alignment of the models.
